items.desc: saas tier 实体链：旗舰版→专业版→基础版，末轮档位分组

turns.q: 上月旗舰版套餐档位的MRR

FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN companies c ON i.company_id = c.company_id JOIN plans p ON l.plan_id = p.plan_id
WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) >= strftime('%Y-%m', date_trunc('month', DATE '2026-09-01') - INTERVAL (0) MONTH) AND p.tier = '旗舰版'

LIMIT 100

items.desc: saas 中途澄清→行业 ARPU 分组→档位毛利额→对比收束

SELECT SUM(l.seats * l.unit_price) AS value

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', i.invoice_date) AS month, i.channel AS channel, SUM(l.seats) AS value
FROM invoice_lines l JOIN invoices i ON l.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN companies c ON i.company_id = c.company_id JOIN plans p ON l.plan_id = p.plan_id
